link.title: Connect this phone
link.text: This phone will be connected to your Bookeeper library. The QR code is valid for a few minutes and works once.

name.label: Device name
name.hint: You will see it in the list of devices on the computer.

intro.title: Connect this phone
intro.text: To use Bookeeper on your phone, it has to be connected to your library. It takes a minute.
intro.stepsLabel: How to get the QR code
intro.step1: On the computer, open Bookeeper and go to Devices.
intro.step2: Tap Add a phone: a QR code appears.
intro.step3: Point the phone camera at the QR code and tap the link.

code.title: Enter the code
code.text: On the computer, under Devices → Add a phone, the code is also written below the QR code.
code.label: Pairing code
code.hint: Capitals, spaces and dashes do not matter.
code.back: How do I get a code?

already.title: Phone already connected
already.text: This phone is already connected to {library}. Do you want to connect it again?
already.textUnknown: This phone is already connected to a library. Do you want to connect it again?

errors.codeEmpty: Type the code shown on the computer.
errors.invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Generate a new one on the computer (Devices → Add a phone) and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach Bookeeper. Check the phone's connection and try again.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.label: Your name
invite.hint: This is the name the others in the library will see.
